title: game-from-gibberish: seed.py mojibakes the em dash on Windows
description: GH#4. seed.py never pins sys.stdout encoding, so the em dash in the printed casting is written as cp1252 0x97 on a Windows console. Any UTF-8 consumer (pipe, redirect, subagent) sees a corrupted char, and SKILL.md step 3 says to copy that casting into SEED.md.
close_reason: Fixed in 8569118: pinned sys.stdout/stderr to UTF-8 with errors=replace. Verified 0x97 before, E2 80 94 after, casting content identical.

title: godot-game-ui: shell-screen button captions cannot be changed without forking the template
description: GH#3 defect 2. results_screen.gd, pause_menu.gd, title_screen.gd hardcode 'Play again'/'Main menu'/'Resume'/'Quit' etc. ResultsScreen already exports heading, so the title is configurable while the buttons are not. Export the captions with unchanged defaults.
close_reason: Fixed in 732054e: captions exported as again/menu/resume/restart/quit/play_label in both skills, defaults verbatim. Verified defaults + overrides in Godot 4.7.1.

title: godot-game-ui: backdrop colour is a literal in 4 templates, unreachable from the palette
description: GH#3 defect 1. results_screen.gd and title_screen.gd in both UI skills call UiTheme.backdrop(Color(0.06,0.05,0.07,1.0)) — an opaque near-copy of UiTheme.BACKDROP. Re-skinning the PALETTE block leaves the backdrop at the old colour, which is exactly what SKILL.md idea 1 forbids.
close_reason: Fixed in 2fc99b4: BACKDROP_OPAQUE, CHIP_INK, SLOT_EMPTY added to palette; 4 literal sites routed through them in both skills. Re-skin walk fails on all 4 pre-fix, passes post-fix; smoke+juice green.
